universal_lens: A spatiotemporal transition model maps player and ball dynamics to real-time possession value using high-frequency tracking data. EPV models possession value as conditional expectation of future points, leveraging spatiotemporal state transitions to infer decision quality and strategic intent.
gsi_mapping: Bayesian inference on possession value conditioned on tracked states uses conformal prediction for uncertainty quantification. GSI employs Bayesian inference to update EPV estimates using real-time player tracking data, conformally validating decision-making under uncertainty via posterior predictive distributions.
gse_mapping: Situational reasoning encodes state transitions via Markov chains over player positions and ball trajectories for tactical decision-making. GSE encodes EPV as a Markovian state-transition system, where each decision node triggers probabilistic updates to expected scoring outcomes based on current spatial configuration.
